metadata.title: Phase 20 Scientific Integrity & Claim Verification Audit

coral_label_isolation.rule: DomainAdapter never accepts or uses ground truth labels during fit or transform.

min_calibration_samples.basis: Mathematical sample covariance rank requirement (N >= 25 in streaming) ensuring positive definiteness

drift_frobenius_threshold.basis: Separation of stationary noise (0.24 +/- 0.05) from genuine operating load shifts (> 2.0)

kurtosis_threshold.basis: Statistical property of impulsive vibration (Gaussian kurtosis = 3.0; non-Gaussian fault impacts > 4.5)

fault_prob_threshold.basis: Conservative operational safety limit for defect suspicion; prevents adapting away true faults

phase14_zero_shot.claimed: Zero-shot model failed on Paderborn due to domain shift (macro F1 ~ 0.25).

phase15_failure_analysis.claimed: Domain shift caused by sensor placement, physical units, and spectral shift.

phase16_domain_generalization.claimed: Genuine order tracking impossible without tachometer; unsupervised CORAL viable.

phase17_coral_validation.claimed: Unsupervised CORAL improves macro F1 to ~0.76 on unseen Paderborn recordings with zero label leakage.

phase18_adaptive_streaming.claimed: Adaptive streaming pipeline operates smoothly with graceful uncalibrated fallback.

phase19_system_hardening.claimed: CPU containerization, Prometheus metrics, safe drift monitoring, fault suppression guardrails.

documented_nuances.description: Streaming is evaluated via verified historical file replay simulating 12 kHz arrival rates. Physical industrial DAQ hardware (e.g. NI-DAQmx) would require a hardware driver adapter.
Docker CLI v29.7.2 is installed; Docker Desktop daemon is currently stopped on the host. Container configurations are validated via automated AST and Compose contracts.
CORAL calibration requires 25-50 unlabeled windows of running machine data. If a machine is deployed already broken during initial calibration, baseline mode must be used.
